description: Deploy the application with its own deploy script, gated by build and test validation, verified by a health check, tagged, and audited. aidd orchestrates; the project owns the deploy command and credentials.
name: deploy

parameters.description: Command that performs the deployment (runs in the project directory)
parameters.name: deployCommand

parameters.description: URL to poll after deploying (e.g. https://example.com/api/v1/health); empty skips the check
parameters.name: healthUrl

configJson.command: if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo "refusing to deploy: working tree has uncommitted changes" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "working tree clean"

if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo "refusing to deploy: validation or the audit left uncommitted changes; commit them so the deployed tree matches a commit and can be tagged" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "working tree still clean after validation"

if [ -n "{healthUrl}" ]; then curl --fail --silent --show-error --retry 5 --retry-delay 3 --retry-all-errors "{healthUrl}" > /dev/null && echo "healthy: {healthUrl}"; else echo "No healthUrl provided; skipping health check"; fi

if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo "skipping tag: validation left uncommitted changes, so the tag would not match what was deployed" >&2; exit 1; fi; git tag "deploy-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)" && echo "tagged $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)"
